scope: All 123 protocol operation declarations, all 469 frontend transport occurrences, existing shared application workflows and reviewed producer requirements. Occurrences, source failures and functional paths are different row categories.

statusSemantics.PASS: Reserved for the explicitly asserted execution scope with actual evidence; no matrix row is marked PASS in this preparation.
statusSemantics.FAIL: Observed source/runtime behavior violates the asserted contract at the recorded revision; functionalAcceptance remains independently NOT TESTED.
statusSemantics.NOT_TESTED: No matching operation/browser E2E was completed. Supporting HTTP200, registry presence, unit tests and source inventory do not change this status.

networkGate: Actual Signet before Mainnet release, or an explicitly documented technically justified actual chain Testnet where Signet is unsupported. Preserve honest unsupported responses. No Mainnet functional transactions.
